metadata_caption: Officially starting our next adventure! 🥹❤️ backstory ::: After 2 sleepless nights in the hospital, we were ready to take Ellie bean home! We had to stay 2 nights to have Ellie fully checked out and to watch Kay because of some problems that arose after birth. Kay recovered well and Ellie performed perfectly on all of her tests! I packed up our bags and got them all loaded, then brought the car seat to the room! We put Ellie in the car seat for the first time and walked her out to the car. It felt so bittersweet leaving the hospital, because we were also leaving behind the end of Kay’s pregnancy journey. We are a little sad to see that come to an end, but are so overjoyed to start this new adventure! ❤️🥹 #kayandtayofficial #couples #relationships #postpartum
